== Summary ==
Identified: [[Emil Wallin]] (blonde bun, white shirt; same clothing as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 3.jpg]]) and [[Tamás Papp]] (grey shirt, white watch, denim shorts; same face as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 3.jpg]]). The man in the pink shirt (sunglasses on his collar) is not named.

Players at the venue at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, 1 June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date:''' 1 June 2023
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-05-31
* '''Identification:''' [[Emil Wallin]] (blonde bun, white shirt; same clothing as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 3.jpg]]) and [[Tamás Papp]] (grey shirt, white watch, denim shorts; same face as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 3.jpg]]). The man in the pink shirt (sunglasses on his collar) is not named.
